mainText: Military air strikes in northeast Nigeria resulted in dozens of deaths according to Amnesty International.

mainText: President Trump stated the U.S. Navy will blockade the Strait of Hormuz after ceasefire talks ended without agreement.

titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, BBC News
